## Featured Web Development Projects
1. **HostelSarathi**: Nepal's leading digital hostel finding platform with real-time room availability, resident management system, map integrations, and multi-role dashboards.
2. **AI-MOS Enterprise Platform**: AI-driven Enterprise Management Operating System featuring corporate knowledge bases, GraphQL APIs, and custom task scheduling engines.
3. **Prabidhi Nepal Web Experience**: Award-winning 3D interactive web journey built with React Three Fiber showcasing tech innovation districts in Nepal.
4. **Cricket Live AI Commentary Pipeline**: Real-time cricket match commentary synthesis pipeline integrating CricAPI, Groq LLM (Llama 3.1), and Edge-TTS audio generation.
